test_lines.zh: 汉字就像一幅画，每个笔画都有它的故事。
test_lines.pinyin: Hànzì jiù xiàng yī fú huà, měi gè bǐhuà dōu yǒu tā de gùshì.
test_lines.en: Chinese characters are like paintings, each stroke has its own story.
test_lines.tone_notes: 三声 on '画' should be perfect, slight pause before '故事'

test_lines.zh: 学习中文，心要静，气要沉。
test_lines.pinyin: Xuéxí zhōngwén, xīn yào jìng, qì yào chén.
test_lines.en: When learning Chinese, your mind must be calm, your energy settled.

test_lines.zh: 诶，你听说了吗？那家新开的奶茶店特别好喝！
test_lines.pinyin: Éi, nǐ tīng shuō le ma? Nà jiā xīn kāi de nǎichá diàn tèbié hǎo hē!
test_lines.en: Hey, have you heard? That newly opened milk tea shop is really good!
test_lines.slang_notes: Use 诶 for natural Beijing girl attention-getter

test_lines.zh: 走吧走吧，我带你去吃煎饼果子！
test_lines.pinyin: Zǒu ba zǒu ba, wǒ dài nǐ qù chī jiānbing guǒzi!
test_lines.en: Let's go, let's go, I'll take you to eat jianbing!

test_lines.pinyin: Zhège... zěnme shuō? Wǒ... wǒ wàng le.
test_lines.en: This... how do you say it? I... I forgot.

test_lines.zh: 哇！我终于学会了！太开心了！
test_lines.pinyin: Wā! Wǒ zhōngyú xué huì le! Tài kāixīn le!
test_lines.en: Wow! I finally learned it! So happy!

test_lines.pinyin: Zài lái! Zhè cì yào zhùyì bǐ fēng.
test_lines.en: Again! This time pay attention to the brush tip.

test_lines.zh: 功夫不负有心人。你进步了。
test_lines.pinyin: Gōngfū bù fù yǒuxīn rén. Nǐ jìnbù le.
test_lines.en: Hard work pays off. You've improved.
